description: Input to a session whose shell already exited refuses: the kept session is scrollback history, not a shell. It stays attachable until closed or reaped — the exit is not a deletion (LW9).

data.what: the shell of terminal "t-7f3a" exited on its own; the session is kept only to serve its scrollback
data.means: nothing was typed and nothing will run — the kept session is history, not a shell
